{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Cross-tabulate arm with key covariates
covariates = ['age', 'severity', 'sex', 'site']

for cov in covariates:
    contingency = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df[cov])
    print(f"\nContingency table for arm vs {cov}:")
    print(contingency)
    
    # Check if proportions are similar
    prop_treatment = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'][cov].value_counts(normalize=True)
    prop_control = df[df['arm'] == 'control'][cov].value_counts(normalize=True)
    
    print(f"\nProportion of {cov} by arm:")
    print(pd.concat([prop_treatment, prop_control], axis=1, keys=['treatment', 'control']))"}
